title: Cab booking system design
idea: A cab booking design matches a rider to a free driver through a swappable matching strategy, then tracks the trip as a ride with strict state transitions.
points: Core classes: `Rider`, `Driver`, `Ride`, `RideService` and a matching strategy.
`Ride` owns its state and refuses any transition the table does not allow.
`RideService` picks a driver and marks them busy in one synchronous step.
Matching is injected, so nearest-driver can become rating-based without edits.

edges.label: match
edges.caption: `RideService` asks the strategy for a free driver, marks them busy, and moves the ride to `ACCEPTED`.

edges.label: pickup
edges.caption: The driver reaches the rider and starts the trip. Only an accepted ride can start.

edges.label: drop
edges.caption: At drop-off the ride completes, the fare is computed, and the driver becomes free again.

edges.label: cancel
edges.caption: A rider may cancel before a driver is matched. No driver is claimed yet.

edges.label: cancel
edges.caption: After acceptance, cancelling must free the claimed driver. `STARTED` has no cancel arrow, so a trip in progress must finish.

code.title: Match, claim, finish
code.caption: Positions are grid points, so distance is easy to check by hand. Write a `FirstFreeDriver` strategy that returns the first free driver, and pass it in.

walk.text: The strategy only chooses among free drivers. It never changes any state.
The allowed transitions live in one table, so the rules are easy to read.
`moveTo` rejects any jump the table does not list, such as skipping `STARTED`.
Pick and claim run with no `await` between them, so no other request can sneak in.
Finishing frees the driver only after the state change succeeds.
Ben gets the far driver because the near one is busy; Cleo gets none.
Finishing an accepted ride is refused. After `STARTED`, it completes and D2 is free.

pitfalls: Never `await` between choosing a driver and marking them busy; two riders can win.
Do not set `ride.state` from outside; route every change through one checked method.
Free the driver on cancel too, or they stay busy forever.

quiz.why: A only lists B, so A to C is refused. C has no entry, and `?? []` turns that into an empty list instead of a crash.

takeaway: Match with a strategy, claim atomically, and let the ride guard its states.

starters: How would surge pricing fit into this design?
How do two servers avoid assigning the same driver?
What if the matched driver rejects the ride?
